Charles Wesley: hymns in Tonic Solfa

Charles Wesley (1707–1788) · Hymn writer

6 hymns on NoteFusion credit Charles Wesley. Each is written out in Tonic Solfa under the words, with staff notation, a piano to sing along with and a free PDF to print.

Words

  • And Can It Be

    And can it be that I should gain

    Doh is F3/4Tune: FILLMORESolfa PDF

  • Come, Thou Long-Expected Jesus

    Come, Thou long expected Jesus

    Doh is C2/4Tune: JEFFERSONSolfa PDF

  • Hark! The Herald Angels Sing

    Hark! the herald angels sing

    Doh is F4/4Tune: MENDELSSOHNSolfa PDF

  • Jesus Christ Is Risen Today

    Jesus Christ is risen today, Alleluia!

    Doh is C4/4Tune: EASTER HYMNSolfa PDF

  • Lo! He Comes with Clouds Descending

    Lo! He comes with clouds descending,

    Doh is G4/4Tune: HELMSLEYSolfa PDF

  • O for a Thousand Tongues

    O for a thousand tongues to sing

    Doh is Ab3/2Tune: AZMONSolfa PDF
